changes.title: Literal text in report exports
changes.text: Markdown tables preserve backslashes in headings and values, including text next to pipes or formatting characters.

changes.title: Report export regressions
changes.text: Check literal backslashes, pipes, line breaks and empty cells while preserving original report values and other export formats.

changes.title: Reliable native touch assertions
changes.text: Native menu tests wait for actual preference changes after touch input, retaining the same assertions and exact application APK.

changes.title: Complete native evidence
changes.text: Retain all screenshots and derive test reports from actual Android execution records; exact display checks reject mismatched screen sizes.

changes.title: Exact tall-display verification
changes.text: Verify a real 1080×2408 emulator display after dismissing Android's first-use full-screen notice.

changes.title: Verified private delivery
changes.text: Verify source, signing, test identities and download checksums before privately publishing existing APK and report assets.

changes.title: Same-APK Android reruns
changes.text: Reuse one signed application APK for complete native regression and representative display checks.

changes.title: Build evidence and audit continuity
changes.text: Preserve the previous APK's exact source, failures, delivery receipt and unfinished audit checkpoints; record this build's reviewed changes separately.

commentary: I corrected a small export issue without changing the recorded values. The earlier test and delivery corrections are recorded separately from gameplay changes.
